abilities.name: Bear Summon (Howl of the Pack Leader)

Altar of Fangs.description: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
The Twin Fangs' [Eternal Venom] accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with [Caustic Deluge] forming [Caustic Globules] and calls her progeny with [Venomous Emergence]. Ithraz consumes players with [Ravenous Feast] and strikes repeatedly with [Stone Breaker].

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a [Vile Flood] while Ithraz spews globs of gore during [Sanguine Storm].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


$bullet;[Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


$bullet;[Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Globules] form near the [Caustic Deluge] target.


$bullet;If [Stone Breaker] strikes no players, it instead strikes all players.

Den of Nalorakk.description: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
The Loa of War spares no mortal as the final trial, assailing players with [Echoing Maul] and pushing them with [Forceful Roar].

At 100 energy, Nalorakk casts [Fury of the War God], slamming Zul'jarra across the arena and incapacitating her with [Concussive Shock]. Nalorakk commands Echoes of Nalorakk to charge the defenseless Zul'jarra, casting [Echoing Fury] when colliding with the first target they encounter.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Fury of the War God] sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast [Echoing Fury] on the first target they encounter.
$bullet; Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].
$bullet; Nalorakk's [Forceful Roar] pushes all players away.

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Overwhelming Onslaught] inflicts significant damage even while protected from Zul'jarra's [Defensive Stance].
$bullet; Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].
$bullet; Nalorakk's [Forceful Roar] pushes all players away.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; Zul'jarra's [Defensive Stance] greatly reduces Nalorakk's [Overwhelming Onslaught].
$bullet; [Fury of the War God] sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast [Echoing Fury] on the first target they encounter.
$bullet; Each Echo of Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul] when Nalorakk casts [Echoing Maul].

Entombed Sentinels.description: The Blood and Breath of Ula'tek bar the way to Vashnik's inner sanctum. Ancient golems that long stood guard within the vaults, now corrupted by the venom of the nightmarish monster they imprisoned.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
The Sentinel Golems of Ula'tek are filled with the caustic venoms flowing throughout the temple. The Breath of Ula'tek animates venom to destroy invaders while the Blood of Ula'tek infects players with deadly toxins. 

At 100 energy the Sentinels come together to fill their venom levels with [Vitriolic Stasis], restoring health to the weaker Sentinel and infecting all players with [Helical Toxins].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;[Toxic Droplets] sprays droplets of venom in front of the Breath of Ula'tek.
$bullet;[Empowering Slam] and [Bloodvenom Injection] increase in intensity each time they strike the same target.
$bullet;[Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Venom Coagulation] creates a massive slime that uses [Contaminate] until it is destroyed.
$bullet;[Vitriolic Stasis] restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the healthier Sentinel.
$bullet;[Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Blighted Blood] infects players and can be dispelled.
$bullet;[Helical Toxins] is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly 4 applications.
$bullet;[Contaminate] inflicts a high amount of damage to all players.

sections.title: Vashnik the Malignant
sections.text: Constantly seeking to improve his toxins, Vashnik infects players and obfuscates their attempts to save themselves.

Kings' Rest.description: After turning on Xal'atath, the fallen king Salhadaar has become a captive of the very Shadowguard he once commanded. Tortured, delirious, and infused with the Void, he awaits his death--or a chance to win his people's freedom from Xal'atath's grasp.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Fallen-King Salhadaar is infused with power from the surrounding machinery, slowly increasing his energy over time. Upon reaching 100 energy, he is overwhelmed by the Void and begins his [Entropic Unraveling]. 

Periodically, the Riftlabs produce orbs of Concentrated Void that are drawn toward Salhadaar. When an orb of Concentrated Void reaches him, he performs a [Void Infusion].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a [Void Infusion] when they reach Salhadaar.
$bullet; Salhadaar takes increased damage during [Entropic Unraveling].
$bullet; Salhadaar creates several Fractured Images that cast [Shadow Fracture].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; When orbs of Concentrated Void are destroyed, they apply [Dark Radiation] to all players.
$bullet; [Despotic Command] inflicts periodic damage to nearby players and applies [Oppressive Darkness] when removed.
$bullet; [Entropic Unraveling] inflicts heavy periodic damage to all players.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a [Void Infusion] when they reach Salhadaar.
$bullet; Spikes erupt from the target of [Shattering Twilight].
$bullet; Salhadaar's melee attacks apply [Destabilizing Strikes].

sections.title: Concentrated Void
sections.text: An orb of dark energy that is drawn towards Salhadaar.

sections.title: Concentrated Void
sections.text: An orb of dark energy that is drawn towards Salhadaar.

sections.title: Concentrated Void
sections.text: An orb of dark energy that is drawn toward Salhadaar.

sections.title: Enduring Void
sections.text: An orb remnant of dark energy that is drawn toward Salhadaar. Reactivated during [Void Convergence].

Kith'ix.description: Defeated long ago, Kith'ix was restrained deep in the Vaults of Ula'tek by Ula'tek herself. With her defeat, the C'Thraxxi has returned, intent on wiping out not just the Amani, but any who would oppose him.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Kith'ix calls upon his [Voidswarm] to fight alongside him as he assaults players with an array of powerful dark magic.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Kith'ix attempts to smother his enemies with [Suffocating Darkness]. Lady Liadrin holds the darkness at bay while gathering power to banish it with [Divine Radiance].

At 25% health, Kith'ix stuns players with [Stygian Howl] and Liadrin rescues them with [Last Light], beginning a race to slay Kith'ix before his [Eightfold Eclipse] snuffs out Liadrin's light.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text: $bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; Aqir that are not slain before Kith'ix casts [Suffocating Darkness] become greatly empowered.
$bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; Aqir that are not slain before Kith'ix casts [Suffocating Darkness] become greatly empowered.
$bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].
$bullet; Applications of [Digestive Juices] can stack and inflict heavy damage if [Gut Reaction] is triggered in rapid succession.

sections.title: Healers
sections.text: $bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Abyssal Grasp] drags players into the darkness if its heal absorb effect is not removed quickly enough.
$bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Abyssal Grasp] drags players into the darkness if its heal absorb effect is not removed quickly enough.
$bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].
$bullet; Applications of [Digestive Juices] can stack and inflict heavy damage if [Gut Reaction] is triggered in rapid succession.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text: $bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; Kith'ix's [Commanding Presence] greatly reduces damage taken by nearby aqir.
$bullet; [Dark Devastation] leaves Kith'ix's target [Devastated], greatly increasing damage they take.
$bullet; [Light's Embrace] greatly reduces the damage of [Extinguish].

Nek'zali the Soulcoiler.description: Long ago, the shadow hunter Nek'zali and her followers were entombed for the blasphemous act of summoning Ula'tek. Restored by the very power she unleashed, she calls the other Soulcoilers from their tombs to serve her once more.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
As Nek'zali energizes the [Soulcoil Well] by invoking the [Soulcoil Rite], she provokes the [Restless Amani] to the well. 

Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to begin the [Ritual of Awakening]. Destroying Echoes of Jawae removes their [Tethers of Awakening] and draws her back. 

Upon reaching full energy, she unwinds the Soulcoil and begins [Uncoiling], empowering her with new abilities until her defeat.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Essence Rend] lingers and leaves behind a [Latent Cultist] upon expiration.
$bullet; [Restless Amani] awaken from the sarcophagi on the outer edges of the room, empowered with [Gravebound Advance] until they are destroyed.
$bullet;  Echoes of Jawae awaken during [Soul Transfer] and provide Nek'zali with [Tether of Awakening].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Essence Rend] lingers and leaves behind a [Latent Cultist] upon expiration.
$bullet; [Soulcoil Ignition] inflicts significant damage to all players.
$bullet; [Soulcoil Rite] inflicts deadly damage if too many souls enter the [Soulcoil Well].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; [Possession Barrage] inflicts damage based on the distance each barrage travels.
$bullet;  Echoes of Jawae awaken during [Soul Transfer] and provide Nek'zali with [Tether of Awakening].
$bullet; Nek'zali attacks her target with [Hollowing Strikes].

sections.title: Restless Amani
sections.text: Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the [Soulcoil Well].

sections.title: Intermission: Ritual of Awakening
sections.text: Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to the Soulcoil Well and summons an Echo of Jawae that protects her from harm.

sections.title: Echo of Jawae
sections.text: A spectral echo that protects Nek'zali from harm. Defeating an Echo of Jawae severs their Tether of Awakening.

sections.title: Restless Amani
sections.text: Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the [Soulcoil Well].

sections.title: Stage Two: Uncoiling
sections.text: Nek'zali uncoils the Soulcoil Well, gaining new abilities until defeated.

Nymrissa Wavecaller.description: Nymrissa Wavecaller commands the restless sea itself, concealing her lair beneath shifting tides. Those who dare uncover her sanctuary find her murloc minions eager to answer their mistress' call.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an [Alluring Bubble] within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons [Swirling Whirlpools] to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.

sections.title: Tank
sections.text:
$bullet;[Water Jet] inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target, and removes icy patches of [Lingering Frost].
$bullet;[Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.

sections.title: Tank
sections.text:
$bullet;[Iceblade Flurry] inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target.
$bullet;[Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.

sections.title: Healer
sections.text:
$bullet;[Abyssal Rain] inflicts significant damage to all players.
$bullet;[Alluring Bubble] inflicts a large burst of damage to all players when it [Pops!]

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
$bullet;Murlocs that enter a [Alluring Bubble] become empowered.

sections.title: Bubblefin Shorerunner
sections.text: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.

sections.title: Bubblefin Berserker
sections.text: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.

sections.title: Bubblefin Shorerunner
sections.text: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.

sections.title: Bubblefin Frostscale
sections.text: A deepwater murloc that protects nearby allies.

sections.title: Bubblefin Berserker
sections.text: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.

Ruby Life Pools.description:
Though she was felled by the blade of Sargeras, the Life-Binder's essence escaped the grasp of the Dark Titan. After millennia spent hiding in isolation, Eonar's sanctuary has been discovered by the Legion.

Should her soul fall into the enemy's hands, Eonar's powers of nature and growth will be perverted to make the Burning Crusade unstoppable.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: The forces of the Legion will warp in and charge at Eonar's Essence and attempt to destroy her outright.  Players must defend Eonar until she can gather her energies and strike back at her attackers.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;Fel-Powered Purifiers will divert from their path to Eonar to engage players in combat once damaged.
$bullet;Fel-Infused Destructors will fire at a much faster rate unless engaged in melee combat.
$bullet;Move away from other players when targeted by [Rain of Fel].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;Fel-Powered Purifiers will divert from their path to Eonar to engage players in combat once damaged.
$bullet;Fel-Infused Destructors will fire at a much faster rate unless engaged in melee combat.
$bullet;Avoid getting hit by [Meteor Storm].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;Most creatures are oblivious to your attempts to thwart their advance.
$bullet;Many of your crowd-controlling effects will work here.
$bullet;Move away from other players when targeted by [Rain of Fel].
$bullet;Kite [Spear of Doom] away from the normal walkways to mitigate its impact on the encounter.
$bullet;Eonar will provide portals to board the Paraxis and interrupt its [Final Doom] attack.
$bullet;When interrupting [Final Doom] coordinate which Feedback effect you will take.

sections.title: Dive Down
sections.text: While gliding, use this ability to dive down to the targeted location.

sections.title: The Paraxis
sections.text: The Paraxis spearheads the Legion's invasion against Eonar, launching several different attacks at players to cover the insertion of Legion forces.

sections.title: Final Doom
sections.text: Periodically throughout the encounter, the Paraxis will attempt to annihilate all life in the zone.  Players must enter the Paraxis by using special portals that Eonar creates on her platform.  While there, players must dispatch a Paraxis Inquisitor and then deactivate four Focusing Crystals in order to disrupt the sequence.  Deactivating a crystal gives the player a Feedback application based on the color of the Focusing Crystal.

sections.title: Paraxis Inquisitor
sections.text: The Paraxis Inquisitor controls access to the various control devices aboard the Paraxis. Defeat him to be able to interact with the devices and interrupt the Paraxis' Final Doom attack.

sections.title: Forces of the Legion
sections.text: These creatures warp in at various locations and move directly to Eonar's essence. If they reach her essence they will inflict damage to her until they are defeated.

sections.title: Felguard
sections.text: Standard Legion infantry unit. Not exceptionally fast or hearty.

sections.title: Fel Hound
sections.text: Exceptionall fast, these hounds of the Legion have less health than Felguards.

sections.title: Fel Lord
sections.text: Slow-moving, these elite Legion units have exceptionally high health.

sections.title: Volant Kerapteron
sections.text: These fel bats fly in and take an airborne route to Eonar's essence.

sections.title: Fel-Powered Purifier
sections.text: Removes any active crowd-control effects from nearby allies and grants all nearby allies immunity to crowd-controlling effects.

sections.title: Fel-Infused Destructor
sections.text:
Continually fires upon Eonar's essence until dispatched. If not actively engaged in melee combat will greatly increase rate of fire.
This creature is sessile.

sections.title: Fel-Charged Obfuscator
sections.text: Cloaks nearby allies, making them invisible.  This creature ignores combat.

Sszorak.description: A horrifying creature, warped by Ula'tek's toxic venom, Sszorak is a brutal instrument of vengeance. Calling upon the winds that howl deep within Atal'Utek, it tears apart any living creature it encounters.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with [Apex Predator] combination attacks and noxious [Venomous Surge] globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes [Raging Crosswinds] and eventually builds to a massive [Howling Maelstrom] that pushes players around the arena.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Venomous Surge] inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
$bullet;[Raging Crosswinds] inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
$bullet;[Dig In] increases Sszorak's damage taken during [Howling Maelstrom].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Venomous Surge] inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
$bullet;[Raging Crosswinds] inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
$bullet;When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a [Howling Maelstrom], players are pushed in the wind's direction.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;During [Apex Predator], Sszorak casts a combination of [Ravage] and [Mutilate].
$bullet;[Corroding Venom] increases Physical damage taken. This effect stacks.
$bullet;When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a [Howling Maelstrom], players are pushed in the wind's direction.

Temple of Sethraliss.description: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Essence Defilers arrive to channel [Defiling Taint] upon the Avatar of Sethraliss until their defeat. As part of their assault, Corrupted Guardians appear whose [Corrupted Lifeforce] can be cleansed to heal the Avatar. Upon removal of [Defiling Taint], Faithless Tormentors fixate on the party's healer and attempt to strike them with [Shadowlash]. The battle ends once players fully restore the Avatar.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;Defeating all Essence Defilers cleanses the Avatar of [Defiling Taint].
$bullet;The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
$bullet;After damaging Faithless Tormentors, the Avatar [Siphons the Weak].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet;The battle ends in victory once the Avatar reaches full health.
$bullet;Essence Defilers' [Defiling Taint] and Faithless Tormentors' [Shadowlash] thwart healing.
$bullet;The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;Corrupted Guardians inflict significant Physical and Shadow damage with [Tainted Strike].
$bullet;The Avatar consumes [Corrupted Lifeforce] from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
$bullet;Essence Defilers' [Defiling Taint] and Faithless Tormentors' [Shadowlash] thwart healing.

sections.title: Stage One: Defiler's Corruption
sections.text: Jakra'zet's allies arrive to prevent healing energy from reaching the Avatar.

sections.title: Stage Two: Tormentor's Fixation
sections.text: Faithless Tormentors attempt to disrupt the Avatar's restoration.

sections.title: Avatar of Sethraliss
sections.text: The battle concludes upon full restoration of the Avatar of Sethraliss.

The Coiled Altar.description: The spirit of Malacrass will not release his grip on Zul'jan so easily. At the Coiled Altar, the shaman commands the warrior to enact the final ritual to unleash Ula'tek on the Amani--for revenge, and to gain their promised reward.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
A mutated Zul'jan unleashes his new power by [Coalescing Venom] within The Coiled Altar. He wields twin axes that [Sever] players and destroy Coalesced Venom.

Upon Zul'jan's defeat, Malacrass joins the fray. Malacrass haunts players with [Dreadmarch], creating Manifestations of Dread as it resolves. His casts of [Soul Sever] hurt players and destroy any Manifestations of Dread in its blast.

Upon defeat, Malacrass begins a ritual of [Soulbinding] to revive Zul'jan as his puppet, and claim what is rightfully his.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Toxic Deluge] creates [Coalesced Venom] around the arena.
$bullet; Freeing players possessed by [Dreadmarch] creates [Manifestations of Dread] that fixate on a random player.
$bullet; [Eternal Nightfall] inflicts deadly damage unless [Veil of Twilight] is broken.

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Fangs of the Coiled Altar] and [Defilement of the Coiled Altar] inflict massive damage and healing absorbs to all players.
$bullet; [Coalesced Venom] explode into a [Venom Rupture] when destroyed.
$bullet; [Venomfang] and [Gloombomb] inflict heavy damage.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; [Sever] inflicts a massive amount of damage, destroying [Coalesced Venom].
$bullet; [Soul Sever] afflicts players hit with [Gravebound] and destroys [Manifestations of Dread].
$bullet; [Corrupted Toxin] inflicts stacking moderate damage.

The Lost Explorers.description: A band of tortollans, possessed by spirits, have come to their senses near the sarcophagus of an ancient Soulcoiler. Trapped in the vault, they seek ancient artifacts to protect themselves from further possession by vengeful spirits.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Mor'zahi uses [Dark Whispers] to gain control over a group of tortollan explorers he has lured into the temple. If his control over them is broken, Mor'zahi casts [Mor'zahi's Command], expending all of his energy to reassert control and grant the target additional abilities.

Mor'zahi inflicts deadly damage if he is allowed to finish casting [Final Ascension].

Mor'zahi's concentration can be broken if a tortollan he is controlling consumes a Disgusting Fish.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; Frost and Fire patches left behind by [Frostfire Volley] can be removed by the opposing elemental effects of [Burning Flames] and [Piercing Frost].
$bullet; [Mighty Thud] inflicts very high damage to all players. Each impact inflicts damage split evenly between players directly hit.
$bullet; Trader Gebbo's [Explosive Surprise] triggers [Blast Wave], which can be avoided using the mushrooms from [Mushroom Toss].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Blink Nova] inflicts high damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Epu's target receive less damage.
$bullet; [Icebound Flames] inflicts high damage to a player if Scrollsage Epu is not interrupted, but the lingering effects can be dispelled.
$bullet; [Splinters] inflicts damage over time to any players who stomp on crates thrown by Trader Gebbo.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; [Shredding Shards] from Scrollsage Epu inflicts high magic damage and vulnerability to this effect to the current target.
$bullet; First Mate Nema's attacks against his current target gain increasing Physical damage from [Steady Strikes].
$bullet; First Mate Nema grants [United Defense] to the tortollan explorers when Scrollsage Epu and Trader Gebbo are both near him.

sections.title: Disgusting Fish
sections.text: A fish found within one of Trader Gebbo's boxes. Tossing it to a possessed tortollan interrupts Mor'zahi and causes him to repossess them with Mor'zahi's Command.

sections.title: Bouncy Mushroom
sections.text: Jumping on a Bouncy Mushroom will bounce a player high into the air but will perturb the mushroom, triggering Fungal Burst soon after.

The Twin Fangs.description: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
The Twin Fangs' [Eternal Venom] accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with [Caustic Deluge] forming [Caustic Globules] and calls her progeny with [Venomous Emergence]. Ithraz consumes players with [Ravenous Feast] and strikes repeatedly with [Stone Breaker].

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a [Vile Flood] while Ithraz spews globs of gore during [Sanguine Storm].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


$bullet;[Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


$bullet;[Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet;[Caustic Globules] form near the [Caustic Deluge] target.


$bullet;If [Stone Breaker] strikes no players, it instead strikes all players.

Ula'tek.description: The great shame of the Amani empire. The vast complex of Atal'Utek was created to imprison the weapon that proved to be as much of a threat as the enemy she was intended to destroy. Ula'tek has risen from her ancient slumber and threatens all of Azeroth if she should escape.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Ula'tek splashes venom across her platform with [Caustic Waves]. Any Blightscale Spawn that touch her venom hatches and covers players in a [Putrid Membrane]. While her slithering children continue to spawn, Ula'tek uses her [Spectral Coils] to shatter the space.

After Ula'tek rails against her prison with [Rage of the Shackled] she summons her faithful then dives beneath the venom to gather her strength. Ula'tek's Doomscale Wardens move between the Blightscale Spawn imbuing them with [Writhing Gestation] as the Doomscale Eggs begin to hatch.

With her progeny broken, Ula'tek shatters the arena. She continues to use [Call of the Serpent] to gather her forces while destroying the only safe spaces remaining with [Circling Prey].

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; Blightscale Spawn hatch a Blightscale Viper when they connect with venom.
$bullet; A [Blightscale Clutch] grows in power unless destroyed.
$bullet; Doomscale Wardens use [Writhing Gestation] on nearby Blightscale Spawn.

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; Every Blightscale Viper hatched inflicts [Putrid Membrane] to all players.
$bullet; [Spectral Coils] inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.

sections.title: Tank
sections.text:
$bullet; Ula'tek uses [Unchecked Rage] while not engaged in melee combat.
$bullet; Ula'tek's Gore Rattle uses [Rattler Slam] while not engaged in melee combat. 
$bullet;[Mother's Wrath] inflicts damage to everyone while no one is in its area of effect.

Vashnik the Malignant.description: Within The Chamber of Virulence, Vashnik the Malignant distills Ula'tek's venoms into ever more lethal forms. The creature lurks in its noxious chamber, brewing foul toxins to empower its brood.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Vashnik [Imbibes] from the nearest two fountains, increasing his affinity to them. These fountains erupt with vapor, bringing forth living venoms that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity in the center of the chamber.

Should a living venom reach its destination, a [Malignant Burst] occurs.

sections.title: Damage Dealers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Imbibe] creates living venom from two nearby fountains.

$bullet; Living venoms explode in [Malignant Bursts] unless destroyed.

$bullet; The initial Clotting Venom is protected by [Sanguineous Fortitude].

sections.title: Healers
sections.text:
$bullet; [Imbibe] inflicts heavy damage to all players.

$bullet; Vashnik's chamber fills with increasing [Toxic Vapor] each time he [Imbibes].

$bullet; [Siphoning Infection] absorbs a large amount of incoming healing.

sections.title: Tanks
sections.text:
$bullet; [Dripping Fangs] inflicts increasing damage over time.

$bullet; [Imbibe] infuses Vashnik with the power of two nearby fountains.
